rules.text: In combat, enter the Claws of Night Taijutsu stance (the clan's stance item).

activities.label: Echolocation
activities.text: Bonus action, 1 minute: blindsight 30 feet while you can hear (not while Deafened or muffled); a rank of Mastery on sound-based Perception.

activities.label: Pinging
activities.text: Bonus action: creatures within 10 feet of a point within 30 feet (45 at 7th, 60 at 15th) until the start of your next turn: your attacks against them can't be at disadvantage; allies they can't see get attacks of opportunity on them.

activities.label: Hypnotic Voice

tiers.success: Success: Confused until the end of its next turn.
tiers.critFailure: Critical Failure: as a failure, and Slowed.

activities.text: Action: creatures of your choice in a 20-foot cone (40 at 11th). A Genjutsu of your highest rank.

activities.label: Hypnotic Gaze

tiers.success: Success: Charmed until the end of its next turn.
tiers.failure: Failure: Charmed, and for 1 minute it spends its Movement and Actions obeying one command.
tiers.critFailure: Critical Failure: as a failure, obeying new orders you give as a Bonus action for 1 minute; damage lets it resave once per turn.

activities.text: Action, concentration: a creature you can see within 30 feet. A Genjutsu of your highest rank; a failure or worse can't recur on it until you rest.

rules.text: Entering a social encounter: Patient (no jutsu or feature bonuses this encounter; gain a Will of Night, one at a time: two ranks of Mastery on Wisdom and Charisma skill checks for 1 minute), Impatient (a rank of Mastery on one skill this encounter; fail 2+ checks and the attitude drops 2 ranks), or neither.
After a rest pick two abilities until your next rest (the option items). They use your highest jutsu save DC and attack bonus.

activities.label: Dread Weave
activities.text: Once per turn, layered onto a Visual or Auditory Genjutsu: on its failed save, 1 rank of Shaken; critical failure, Shaken and Berserk (+1 rank of Shaken with 2+ ranks of Demoralized). Use the Genjutsu's own save.

rules.text: (Its copy of Umbral Monarch's Amp is removed, as King Q-E12.)

roll.note: Bonus action, not in direct sunlight: teleport up to 40 feet (60 at 11th) to a space you can see. Then not again until you cast a C-Rank or higher Ninjutsu or Genjutsu that costs chakra.

rules.text: Creatures your Genjutsu summon, or with the Illusory Construct trait: +5 + your level hit points; their first damage each turn +2 (+4 at 11th).

activities.label: Umbral Domain

tiers.failure: Failure: 4d8 psychic and 1 rank of Demoralized.
tiers.critFailure: Critical Failure: 6d8 psychic and 2 ranks of Demoralized.

activities.text: Action: a 30-foot radius within 60 feet for 1 minute (chakra darkness and difficult terrain, not for you). A hostile creature starting its turn there. A C-Rank Visual, Tactile Genjutsu.

roll.note: Reaction, taking damage: it loses 2 of its damage dice (3 at 15th). Then not again until you cast a C-Rank or higher Taijutsu or Bukijutsu that costs chakra.

rules.text: Choose Dominion or Requiem (the option items); changing takes a ritual during a Full Rest.

activities.label: Dominion: compel
activities.text: Teleporting into dim light or darkness next to a Berserk, Charmed, Confused, Demoralized or Shaken creature. Failure: it spends its movement, action and bonus action harming a creature you pick until it has damaged it 3 times. Passing by 5: immune until you rest.

rules.text: On initiative: Echolocation's blindsight becomes 40 feet.

activities.label: Requiem: siphon
activities.text: Bonus action: creatures within 30 feet lose all Bleed and Crimson Hemorrhage; per rank, regain 1d6 or gain 6 temporary hit points (pick; roll once per rank).

rules.text: On initiative: in Claws of Night or Umbral Monarch, +15 speed and +1 attack with the Attack action. Creatures with Bleed or Crimson Hemorrhage: +1 critical range for your unarmed and weapon attacks against them.

activities.label: Crimson Hemorrhage
activities.text: Once per turn, [Weapon Damage] with a one-handed Blade or [Unarmed Damage]. Failure: a rank of Crimson Hemorrhage.

rules.text: The Claws of Night Taijutsu stance (its text is Claws of Night's stance part, as King Q-E9): [Unarmed Damage] 1d8 slashing; once per turn a Bruised you inflict can be 1 rank of Bleed instead; once per turn, [Weapon Damage] with a one-handed Blade or [Unarmed Damage]: the save for Crimson Hemorrhage. At 7th, without Extra Attack, the Attack action attacks twice.

activities.label: Umbral Monarch
activities.text: Bonus action, 1 minute. Again before a long rest: 1 rank of Exhaustion.

activities.label: Sonic Lance
activities.text: Action, in Umbral Monarch: a 60 by 5-foot line. Failure: the damage and Deafened until the end of its next turn; success: half.

activities.label: Umbral Shockwave

tiers.success: Success: Dazzled until the end of its next turn.
tiers.failure: Failure: Blinded until the end of its next turn.
tiers.critFailure: Critical Failure: as a failure, and Confused.

activities.text: Action, in Umbral Monarch: a 20-foot radius on you (a Visual, Auditory, Tactile Genjutsu).

activities.label: Crimson Feast
activities.text: Once per turn, your [Unarmed]/[Weapon Damage] to a creature with Crimson Hemorrhage: its ranks drop to 0; regain 1d10 per rank (roll once per rank).

rules.text: Two options (more at 7th and 15th). Anchored Steps: forced movement checks against you at disadvantage; your saves and checks against it at advantage. Dominating Stability: a rank of Mastery on Strength saves. Dinner Bell: on initiative, your Reaction gives a rank of Mastery on d20 rolls until the end of your next turn. Gravestone Dragging: Bulk +5; moving while grappling isn't difficult terrain. Inhuman Stamina: advantage against Exhaustion; after an Action Dash, a Bonus action Dash. Launching Throw: thrown range +20 feet; Mastery on Shove (two at 7th, three at 15th). Vaulted Limbs: climbing speed equal to your speed; fall damage dice reduced by half your level.
